* Arda Tunçel was born in 1995 in Ankara. In 2019, he graduated from Department of International Relations at Ihsan Dogramaci Bilkent University. During his BA, he carried out a research project on ‘One Belt One Road’ and wrote a research paper. He worked as a Student Brand Manager at Red Bull Turkey company in 2017-2019. In September 2019, he began his MA on international trade at Shanghai University. He is currently working on the effects of the Belt and Road Initiative on the relationship between Turkey and China. He is currently a board member of the “Association of Turkish Student in China”. Email: ardatuncel.ch@yandex.com
